verdict.rationale: The repo documents its own packaging layout: Cursor metadata in `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, portable metadata in root `plugin.json`, and a Nix flake that builds the portable layout. It also ships a pre-delivery validator (`node scripts/validate.mjs`) that checks invocation contracts and plugin version parity, so an agent has some project-defined checks when packaging a skill. There is no evidence of a skill-authoring spec, template, or meta-skill that guides an agent through creating a new skill end to end. missing for 10: a documented skill authoring spec or SKILL.md template, a meta-skill for creating skills, an end-to-end authoring-to-packaging walkthrough, and hands-on corroboration that an agent can complete the flow.
